questions.prompt: At Old Mill workplace group, a program coordinator reviews the labeled body-systems diagram with new volunteers during a guided tutorial. The material concerns circulation; learners must distinguish structure from function. Which interpretation best fits the evidence?
options: Circulation transports materials and supports exchange with tissues.

Tendons connect muscle to bone and transmit force.
Regulation helps keep internal conditions within workable ranges.
